mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite upward GDP trend, or GDP growth decelerates in subsequent periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market strengthening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing below 4.5%, or the rate recovers quickly without sustained strength.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both federal funds rate and quarterly GDP growth indicates a dual expansion in monetary policy easing and economic output, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the joint increase in FEDFUNDS and GDPC1, or the relationship reverses in subsequent periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in household demand (HOUST) reflects strengthening consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite HOUST trend, or demand growth slows in later periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the supply index (INDPRO) above 108 signals unexpected supply-side expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite INDPRO crossing above 108, or the effect dissipates quickly.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the joint rise in PAYEMS and UNRATE, or the relationship weakens over time.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, simultaneous rises in federal funds rate and quarterly GDP growth signal a transition to sustainable growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 increase within late-cycle expansion regime
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the joint increase in FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 during the late-cycle regime, or the regime shifts before the signal materializes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rate and decline in unemployment rate indicates coordinated monetary tightening and labor market improvement, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: coordinated monetary and labor market adjustments
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the inverse relationship between FEDFUNDS and UNRATE, or the effect reverses in subsequent periods.
